card.name: Linking words in general prose
card.fires_on: Scattered small linking words (to, from, for, and, we) and occasional word starts in general web prose. No shared setting or word type is clear.

modes.label: Linking word in running prose
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction partway through a general-interest sentence.
modes.example: over 9,000 persons emigrated<< from>> England to Utah.

card.plain: It responds to assorted small linking words in ordinary web text, with no pattern a clinician could use.
